items.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
items.summary: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.
items.title_es: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say

items.title: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics told the WSJ it objected because it was unsure how tokenization would affect its stock price, liquidity and volatility.
items.title_es: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE

items.title: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
items.summary: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million—days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House races.
items.title_es: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown

items.title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
items.summary: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.
items.title_es: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
